issues.explanation: No Pest/PHPUnit tests ship with the change despite conventions requiring tests for every feature and unauthorized plus tamper tests for Livewire actions.
Livewire components use inline $this->validate([...]) without #[Validate] attributes required by the project pattern.
Password reset validates three fields inline instead of using a Form Request once rules grow beyond one or two fields.
Register hits the rate limiter before validation so validation failures also consume attempts, diverging slightly from failed-attempt limiting.

conventions.evidence: app/Livewire/Auth/Login.php:231 and app/Livewire/Auth/Register.php:301 use $this->validate([...]) with no #[Validate]; app/Http/Controllers/NewPasswordController.php:137 validates 3 fields inline with no Form Request; docs synced via CHANGELOG.md:26

readability.evidence: app/Http/Controllers/LogoutController.php:98, app/Http/Controllers/NewPasswordController.php:135, app/Livewire/Auth/Login.php:219 small focused methods with clear names; no dead code or debug output

requirements.evidence: app/Livewire/Auth/Login.php:221-249 strict email, auth.failed/auth.throttle, 5-try key, regenerate, redirectIntended home; app/Livewire/Auth/Register.php:289-321 Password::defaults, confirmed, transliterate key, Registered/login/regenerate; routes/web.php:982-1001 all names/methods/throttles; reset rotates remember_token app/Http/Controllers/NewPasswordController.php:146-152; MustVerifyEmail app/Models/User.php:348

scope.evidence: every hunk serves auth/localization: routes, Livewire, controllers, views, lang/en/ui.php, lang/pt_BR/ui.php, .env.example:6-15, phpunit.xml:511-512; welcome/bulma-test rework required by route() and translation rules

security.evidence: Login rate-limited app/Livewire/Auth/Login.php:221-245 with validation 231-235; verify uses EmailVerificationRequest app/Http/Controllers/Auth/EmailVerificationController.php:58; reset rotates remember_token app/Http/Controllers/NewPasswordController.php:148; all views use {{ }} and route() e.g. resources/views/auth/forgot-password.blade.php:533

simplicity.evidence: Password::defaults configured once app/Providers/AppServiceProvider.php:368; reuses Password facade, EmailVerificationRequest, Auth; no service layers or speculative abstractions

tests.evidence: change.diff contains no tests/* or pest files; no happy-path, validation, unauthorized-call, or tamper tests for Login submit or Register submit

review.summary: Implements the full session auth flow, localization, routes, and view conventions correctly with solid security. Missing entirely the required Pest tests plus #[Validate] attributes, so it needs substantial rework before merging.
